standard.summary: 控制 EMA 副本对历史权重的记忆长度。值越接近 1，平均窗口越长，对最新步的响应越慢。
standard.effect: decay=0.999 ≈ 最近 1000 步加权平均；decay=0.9999 ≈ 最近 10000 步。值越大越平滑，但对训练末期调整的响应越迟钝。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练（>500 步）推荐 0.999~0.9999。短训练可适当降低到 0.99 让 EMA 响应更快。
standard.avoidWhen: decay 设为 1 会完全不更新 EMA（永远等于初始权重）；设为 0 EMA 等于最新步（没有平均效果）。

standard_en.summary: How long the EMA copy remembers earlier weights. The closer to 1, the longer the averaging window and the slower it answers to the latest step.
standard_en.effect: decay=0.999 is roughly a weighted average of the last 1000 steps; decay=0.9999 roughly the last 10000. Larger is smoother but slower to respond to late-run adjustments.
standard_en.whenToUse: 0.999-0.9999 is recommended for long runs (>500 steps). Short runs can drop to 0.99 so the EMA responds faster.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A decay of 1 never updates the EMA (it stays at the initial weights); a decay of 0 makes the EMA equal the latest step (no averaging at all).

advanced.principle: θ_ema = decay × θ_ema + (1-decay) × θ_t，等效记忆步数约为 1/(1-decay)。
advanced.intervention: 仅影响 EMA 副本更新速率，不影响训练主路径。
advanced.expectedImpact: decay 越高平滑效果越强，但需要更多步数才能「追上」训练权重的变化方向。
advanced.tradeoffs: decay 过高在步数不足时 EMA 权重可能长期偏向初始化，导致 EMA 权重质量反而差于直接保存权重。

advanced_en.principle: θ_ema = decay × θ_ema + (1-decay) × θ_t; the equivalent memory horizon is about 1/(1-decay).
advanced_en.intervention: Only affects the EMA replica's update rate; the main training path is untouched.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Higher decay smooths more strongly but needs more steps to "catch up" with the training weights' direction of change.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Decay too high with too few steps can leave the EMA weights biased toward initialization for a long time, making EMA quality worse than directly saved weights.
